description: Save a video the person likes the look of to the workspace's style library: its link (Instagram, TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Facebook or any https page), and/or media_id for a screen recording of it or the person's own export (upload it first with media_upload_url or media_import_url). Put what they like about it in note ("the captions", "fast cuts"). The link is stored, never fetched; share ids and tracking are removed. Up to 100 per workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

media_id.description: A ready video or photo from media_list: a screen recording of the video, or the person's own export.

network.description: Where the video was posted. Taken from the link when it's on one of the five networks.

note.description: What the person likes about it, in their words.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: style_reference_add
title: Add a style reference
